findings.finding: execute_transaction returns Result<GasOutput, BlockExecutionError>; commit_transaction is reached after successful execution processing.
EVM errors map to BlockExecutionError; a successfully obtained EthTxResult supplies its ExecutionResult to ReceiptBuilderCtx and receipt creation.
ReceiptBuilderCtx.result has type ExecutionResult<E::HaltReason>, distinct from Rust Result.
RethReceiptBuilder returns Receipt with success=result.is_success(); no Result::Err return branch in this function.

limitations: Source/type review only; no live Ethereum transaction execution or human comprehension claim.
